dedupe_keys.name: egon data open data pipeline and data model for german energy system planning

description: eGon-data is an open, reproducible data processing pipeline that builds data models for energy system modelling of Germany, covering electricity transmission and distribution grid topologies, demands and demand curves, generation capacities and cross-sectoral flexibility such as gas, heat and electric mobility, at high spatial resolution. It was developed in the eGo_n research project by Flensburg University of Applied Sciences, the Reiner Lemoine Institut, Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg, the DLR Institute of Networked Energy Systems and Europa-Universitaet Flensburg, funded by the German ministry BMWK, to study sector coupling effects on the grid; its output feeds the grid optimisation tools eTraGo, eDisGo and ding0. Coverage is Germany with neighbouring countries, with scenarios such as eGon2035. The Python pipeline writes to a PostgreSQL database, uses an input data bundle archived on Zenodo, and is documented on Read the Docs, with version 2.0.0 released in August 2025. Code is AGPL-3.0-or-later and outputs are published under open licences, at no cost. Caveats: running it needs PostgreSQL, PostGIS, osm2pgsql, Java and API registrations for ERA5 and ENTSO-E data, and the data bundle is about 20 GB. Simulation uses are network flow and capacity planning for transmission and distribution grids. Related records: none linked on the provider's pages read on the day.
